issues.legal_issue: Development charges and fees may be levied under Section 15(2-A) of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act, including in areas within a development authority’s limits that are not covered by a development plan.

Section 15(2-A) of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act permits development authorities to levy only the charges specified there, and does not authorize other charges such as inspection or supervision fees, subdivision charges, or impact fees.

The State Government’s supervisory direction-making power under Section 41 of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act does not authorize it to permit development authorities to levy charges not allowed by Section 15(2-A).

Amounts paid for unauthorized charges must be refunded with 6% annual interest to the original petitioners who challenged the demand notices, subject to adjustment of lawful development charges and fees.
